title: Trust Administrator
description:
Location: Beaminster

Salary £27k-£32k DOE (will pay more for experienced Trust administrator)

Hours: 9am-5.30pm Mon-Thurs, 9am-5pm Fri

Benefits: 25 days hols + Bank hols (including 3 for Christmas shutdown), birthday off, no onsite parking but provide car parking permit for local car park, pension, medical insurance after probation, social events during the year

Aspire Jobs are delighted to be working in an exclusive partnership with our professional services client who are a well-established and growing firm based in West Dorset. They are seeking to recruit a Trust Administrator to join their busy team. This is a perfect time to join a growing and progressive thinking team and firm.

Are you an organised administrator with excellent attention to detail? Do you enjoy working with figures, managing accurate records and being part of a professional team?

Perhaps you already have experience within legal services, finance or trust administration or from within a professional services firm. Or maybe you're looking for the opportunity to develop specialist knowledge in a highly regarded firm where full training will be provided.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established Trusts department in a varied role offering long-term career development.

The Role

Working as part of a busy and supportive team, you'll help administer a portfolio of trusts, ensuring everything is managed accurately, efficiently and in line with legal requirements.

No two days are quite the same and you'll be involved in a wide range of administrative and financial tasks. As this is a new role you will be setting up systems and spreadsheets from scratch so a real chance to make the role your own.

Responsibilities will include:
- Assisting with the administration of trusts
- Maintaining accurate records and documentation
- Processing financial transactions
- Preparing trust accounts and supporting financial administration
- Liaising with clients and professional advisers
- Ensuring deadlines are met and files remain compliant
- Providing general administrative support to the Trusts team

About You

We're much more interested in finding the right person than someone with previous trust experience.

You'll probably have:
- Previous administration experience
- Excellent attention to detail
- Good numerical ability and confidence working with figures
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- A methodical approach to your work
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office particularly Excel

Experience within a legal practice, financial services, accountancy or trust administration would be an advantage but is by no means essential, as full training will be provided.

title: HR Administrator
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent

Are you an organised HR professional with recruitment experience and a passion for delivering an excellent candidate experience? We're looking for a proactive HR & Recruitment Administrator/Coordinator to support a busy HR team across the full employee lifecycle.

- Previous experience in a HR or Recruitment Administration/Coordinator role.
- Strong understanding of recruitment processes and pre-employment screening requirements.
- Knowledge of sponsorship processes and Right to Work legislation.
- Good understanding of employment law and HR best practice.
- Excellent organisation, time management and communication skills.
- Confident managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Experience using HR systems and applicant tracking systems.

What's on Offer?
- Varied and busy role within a supportive HR team.
- Opportunity to be involved in recruitment, HR systems and employee relations.
- Excellent environment for someone looking to broaden their HR experience and develop their career.

This role would suit an HR Administrator, HR Coordinator, Recruitment Coordinator or Recruitment Administrator looking for their next challenge.

What you need to do now

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

- Good IT skills, including experience using order processing, CRM or ERP systems

If you're ready to bring your accuracy and reliability to a Sales Administrator role where you're genuinely valued, we want to hear from you. Apply today with an up-to-date CV or call Claire at Rubicon for more information.

title: Claims Handler - Home / Motor / Insurance - Remote
description:
Technical Claims Handler / Claim Handler / General Insurance / Motor / Home / GI / CII / ACCI / Remote / UK / United Kingdom (Must have full RTW in the UK without sponsorship)

£25,000 - £60,000 + Bonus + Excellent Benefits Fully Remote

(Multiple levels/roles available - salary depending on experience)

We're working with an established and growing General Insurance business that is looking to appoint a Technical Claims Handler to join its team on a fully remote basis.

This is an excellent opportunity for a claims professional with a background in Motor and/or Home Insurance who is looking to take on a more technical role, dealing with complex claims and having greater ownership over decisions and outcomes.

The Role

You'll be responsible for managing a portfolio of technically complex claims from initial notification through to resolution, using your experience and technical knowledge to assess coverage, liability and indemnity and determine the appropriate course of action.

You'll deal with a range of stakeholders including customers, brokers, insurers, loss adjusters, solicitors and other third parties, ensuring claims are handled fairly, efficiently and in line with policy terms and regulatory requirements.

The role will include:
- Managing Motor and Home claims.
- Reviewing policy wordings and assessing coverage, liability and indemnity.
- Investigating claims and reviewing supporting evidence.
- Making technically sound decisions on settlement and claims strategy.
- Negotiating with customers and third parties where required.
- Identifying potential fraud, exaggeration or inconsistencies.
- Managing disputed and escalated claims.
- Supporting colleagues with technical claims queries.
- Ensuring FCA, regulatory and internal requirements are consistently met.
- Maintaining accurate claims records and documentation.

About You

We're looking for someone with General Insurance claims experience who is comfortable dealing with technically challenging cases and making decisions independently.

You'll ideally have experience across Motor or Home claims, although broader General Insurance experience will also be considered.

You'll need to be confident interpreting policy wordings, investigating claims, assessing liability and negotiating appropriate settlements. Just as importantly, you'll be commercially minded, customer-focused and comfortable working autonomously in a remote environment.

CII / ACII qualifications or progress towards them would be advantageous.

What's In It For You?
- £25,000 - £60,000 salary, depending on experience
- Annual bonus
- 100% remote working
- Excellent benefits package
- Generous annual leave
- Pension
- Life assurance
- Professional development and training
- Support towards relevant insurance qualifications
- Genuine long-term career progression
- The opportunity to join a growing insurance business where your technical expertise will be valued

If you're an experienced Technical Claims Handler looking for a genuinely flexible, fully remote opportunity with a strong salary and excellent benefits, we'd love to hear from you.

This will be an exciting time to join due to expansion and new clients coming on board offering career progression and development long-term and being part of their growth.

Key responsibilities:
- Working in a team environment.
- Managing Marine claims cradle to grave overseeing the lifecycle of the claim, Marine claims experience isn't essential as full training and support will be provided
- Being a focal point for key clients including the Lloyds of London market
- Gathering and assessing evidence, checking policy wordings and establishing validity
- Calculating quantum and negotiating settlements up to circa £2m

About you:
- An experienced Claims handler within the Insurance Claims Industry, from a Broking, Insurer or Adjusting environment
- A background in handling claims, being able to interpret policy wordings and establishing validity
- An exceptional communicator verbal and written
- Enjoy working in a team environment as well as being able to work on own initiative
- Be happy to work in an office environment full-time although my client does offer some flexibility should the need to work from home arise
- Have a passion or be interested in sailing or water sports - desirable
- Industry qualifications - ideally, working towards or would like to work towards

Office hours - Monday to Friday 9am-5pm with an hour for lunch with the option to leave early on a Friday, 20 days holiday plus bank holidays with a Birthday day holiday, free parking.
